target.description: one creature (--target), an area (from the area template), or the user itself

center.description: a burst centred on the user (channel energy) or on a point within range

range.description: range in feet (to the target or the burst's centre); 0 = touch

notes.description: rulings the script doesn't apply (the DM handles them)

dmg.description: damage dice at this creature's caster level, e.g. '2d4'

cond.description: condition on a failed save (or without a save), e.g. 'asleep'

cond_rounds.description: Dice (e.g. '1d4') are rolled when it lands.

cond_mods.description: modifiers of a custom condition (one the script doesn't know, e.g. evil eye)

who.description: who an area affects (default: everyone in it)

allies.description: a buff: modifiers for the allies it reaches

anyOf.description: how long a buff lasts (performances: 1, refreshed while maintained)

buff_rounds.description: how long a buff lasts (performances: 1, refreshed while maintained) Dice (e.g. '1d4') are rolled when it lands.

sr.description: the spell's Spell Resistance line: true for 'yes' (incl. 'yes (harmless)', 'yes (object)'), false for 'no' or no SR line (personal spells). See library/pf1e/rules/spell-resistance.md

sr_harmless.description: Spell Resistance: yes (harmless). A resistant creature must lower its SR (standard action) or the caster makes the caster level check

attack.description: the touch attack bonus (ranged touch for a ray: BAB + Dex mod; melee touch: BAB + Str mod), rolled against touch AC before the effect lands

immunity.description: After the effect, the target is immune to it for a while: daze {"rounds": 10, "from": "anyone", "after": "affected"}; a once-a-day hex {"rounds": 14400, "from": "caster", "after": "targeted"}. While immune, a single-target use is refused and an area skips it.

rounds.description: how long (a number, a formula of cl, or dice)

from.description: immune to everyone's use of it, or only that caster's

after.description: only once it took effect (failed save), or as soon as it was targeted

$comment: A spell's or spell-like ability's effect as the script uses it, resolved at the caster's level. Library spell files (library/pf1e/spells/*.md) hold it in a ```spell-effect block, where numbers may be formulas of cl (e.g. "10*cl", dice "{min(cl,5)}d4") and ranges keywords (touch, close, medium, long; library/pf1e/spellcasting.json). A spell without a combat effect: {"utility": true}.
